name: error-midturn
note: Hand-written: a turn that ends in `error` rather than `done`. Exactly one terminal event per turn and it is always last (contract invariant 1), so nothing follows this. An error is NOT a decline — a decline is tokens + done with no tool_call (invariant 4, see decline.json). Reproducing this live means killing the model endpoint mid-turn, so it is authored here instead.
